video.title: AI欧腐《老板对我的R级幻想/My Boss's R-Rated Fantasies About Me》
video.desc:
"Stop undressing me in your head, sir! I'm just your assistant!" —— After a lightning strike, I gain the ability to hear the CEO's inner thoughts. That cold, untouchable billionaire? Every fantasy running through his mind is about bending me over the desk! Hidden lust. Filthy imaginations. Endless office indecency… Who can possibly get any work done? Might as well just give in!!!
"先生，别再在脑子里扒我的衣服了！我只是您的助理！"——一次雷击之后，我竟然能听见总裁的心声。那个高冷禁欲、遥不可及的亿万富豪？他脑子里的每一个幻想，都是把我按在办公桌上！隐秘的欲望，下流的想象，没完没了的办公室春光……这还让人怎么上班？干脆从了算了！！！
